# DOMPurify

Pinned version: 3.4.17. Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.4.17

`purify.min.js` is the upstream distribution, used to sanitize Markdown HTML before
insertion into the preview DOM. The same sanitized DOM supplies HTML and PDF export.
The upstream dual Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 license is included in `LICENSE`.

To update, replace the distribution and license from a pinned upstream release,
update this version, and run the in-app preview security and rendering checks.
